questions.question: What is the antonym of 'Slender'?
questions.rationale: 'Slender' (दुबला-पतला) is the opposite of Stout, Chubby, or Fatty (मोटा, भारी).

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'Omnipotent'?
questions.rationale: 'Omnipotent' (सर्वशक्तिशाली) is the opposite of Powerless, Fragile, Feeble, or Weak (कमजोर).

questions.question: Which word means the opposite of 'Pacify / Assuage'?
questions.rationale: 'Pacify / Assuage' (शांत करना) is opposite in meaning to Inflame, Infuriate, or Provoke (भड़काना)।

questions.question: 'Veteran' is the opposite of:
questions.rationale: 'Veteran' (अनुभवी) is the opposite of Amateur, Fresher, or Tyro (नौसिखिया)।

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'Generous'?
questions.rationale: 'Generous' (उदार, दयालु) is opposite in meaning to Stingy, Miser, or Niggard (कंजूस)।

questions.question: 'Explicit' is the opposite of:
questions.rationale: 'Explicit' (प्रत्यक्ष, स्पष्ट) means clear and direct; its opposites are Confused, Ambiguous, and Obscure (अस्पष्ट)।

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'Miniature'?
questions.rationale: 'Miniature' means very small (बहुत छोटा); its opposites are Titanic, Huge, Gigantic, and Mammoth (विशालकाय)।

questions.question: 'Scarcity' is opposite in meaning to:
questions.rationale: 'Scarcity' (कमी) is the opposite of Supply, Abundance, or Surplus (पूर्ति, प्रचुरता)।

questions.question: The word 'Demolish' most nearly means:
questions.rationale: In the vocabulary list, 'Demolish' matches Ruin/Destroy (नष्ट करना); 'Amend', not demolish, means improve or rectify.

questions.question: The word 'Abhor' most nearly means:
questions.rationale: 'Abhor' matches Hate/Dislike/Loathe (घृणा करना); 'Admire', its near-opposite, means Praise or Appreciate.
